title: COMP Generator Common Page
summary: Official Derivative common Generator COMP page for node viewer, shortcuts, panel memory, clone, load-on-demand, external .tox, reload-on-start, parameter reload, backup, sub-component load, and re-init behavior.
guidance: Use this article for generator-style COMPs where common viewer, shortcut, clone, external .tox, or re-init behavior affects planning.
Keep in Memory is panel-only even though it appears on this common page.
If an external .tox cannot be found, TouchDesigner loads whatever contents were saved in the .toe.
Reload Custom Parameters and Reload Built-In Parameters only affect top-level component parameters.
Use reloadtoxonstart to control startup loading from external .tox; Re-Init Network reloads the .tox if present and then re-initializes from the clone master.
